task.original_goal: Create deterministic stdlib regression coverage for corrupt, missing, malformed and inconsistent offline full-text index manifests and compressed shards, preserving valid index CLI behavior and stable IDs.
task.implementation_hint: Build synthetic temporary manifests/shards and source records; refactor scripts/check_fulltext_index.py only narrowly to expose testable validation and diagnostic errors while preserving existing CLI and normal query assertions; avoid reliance on PRs #22–#24.

acceptance_criteria: A valid minimal synthetic manifest with all 16 correctly mapped gzip shards, matching document IDs and source fixtures passes checker without shipped/generated repository assets.
Missing referenced shard, truncated or invalid gzip, malformed shard JSON, and malformed manifest each exit nonzero with an actionable file/shard-specific error.

Mismatched manifest document IDs, unknown posting article IDs, invalid nibble shard placement, and malformed postings fail nonzero with clear diagnostics; only enforce invariants supported by the existing schema.

Tests use Python standard library, isolated temporary fixtures and deterministic ordering; retain normal valid-index CLI behavior, stable article IDs and existing full-text query regression expectations.
A narrow read-only public GitHub Actions job tests the exact cycle branch head, capturing run URL/ID, head SHA, exit codes and test counts; isolated tests are not Android or full integration proof.
